arcana.name: Arcanum of the Forge
arcana.description:
Merge

You gain Resistance to fire damage. Any fire damage you deal ignores Resistances.

Dismiss

When you dismiss this Arcanum, choose Forge or Inferno:
Forge. You create a basic weapon, armor or shield of your choice (see pages 130 to 133). If you select this option again, the previously created item vanishes. If you create a weapon this way, it deals fire damage instead of physical.
Inferno. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 fire damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Frost
arcana.description:
Merge

You gain Resistance to ice damage and are immune to enraged. Any ice damage you deal ignores Resistances.

Dismiss

Ice Age. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 ice damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Gate
arcana.description:
Merge

You gain Resistance to dark damage. You gain a +1 bonus to your Magic Defense.

Dismiss

When you dismiss this Arcanum, choose Oblivion or Warp:
Oblivion. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 dark damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.
Warp. You teleport yourself and up to five other nearby willing creatures to a location you previously visited, if that location is within 1 travel day.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Grimoire
arcana.description:
Merge

You are able to read, write, speak and understand all languages. You treat your Insight as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).

Dismiss

Oracle. You ask the Game Master a single question. The Game Master must answer truthfully, describing the vision shown to you by the Grimoire. Once used, this dismiss effect will not be available until the next dawn. Furthermore, the same question may never be asked more than once. The Game Master has final say on which questions are too similar to be asked again.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Oak
arcana.description:
Merge

You gain Resistance to earth and poison damage and are immune to poisoned. Whenever you recover Hit Points, you recover 5 additional Hit Points.

Dismiss

Blossom. Choose any number of creatures you can see (you may also choose yourself): each of them recovers from poisoned and also recovers 40 Hit Points. This amount increases to 50 Hit Points if you are level 20 or higher, or to 60 Hit Points if you are level 40 or higher.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Sky
arcana.description:
Merge

You gain Resistance to air and bolt damage. You may use an action to accurately predict weather conditions for the next day within a range of two travel days — the Game Master will tell you what the weather conditions will be.

Dismiss

Thunderstorm. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 bolt damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Sword
arcana.description:
Merge

Your attacks deal 5 extra damage, and all damage dealt by your attacks loses its type and cannot gain a type for as long as you are merged with this Arcanum (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities). When you perform an attack, you may have that attack gain the multi (any number of targets) property. If you do, this Arcanum will be automatically dismissed after the attack is resolved (this is not considered a willing dismiss).

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Tower
arcana.description:
Merge

When you summon this Arcanum, choose a damage type: air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, or ice. Until this Arcanum is dismissed, each of your allies present on the scene gains Resistance to the chosen damage type (you do not gain this Resistance).

Dismiss

Judgment. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 light damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Wheel
arcana.description:
Merge

You are immune to slow. You gain a +1 bonus to your Defense.

Dismiss

Time Freeze. Choose any number of creatures you can see: each of them suffers slow. If a creature chosen this way is already slow, that creature will instead perform one fewer action during their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).

arcana.name: Arcanum of Airmid
arcana.description:
Merge

Herbalist's Favor
When you summon this Arcanum, you gain 3 Medicine Points. When this Arcanum is dismissed, you lose all Medicine Points.
Once per turn during a conflict, you may use an action and spend 1 Medicine Point to choose one ally you can see. If you do, that ally recovers an amount of Hit Points equal to your Crisis score and heals from a single status effect of your choice.

Dismiss

Cleansing Roots
You deal 20 earth damage to every enemy present on the scene, or 30 earth damage if you had no Medicine Points left when you dismiss this Arcanum. Then, if one or more enemies who lost Hit Points this way are affected by one or more spells with a duration of "Scene", instead they are no longer affected by any of those spells.

arcana.name: Arcanum of Baihu
arcana.description:
Merge

Presence of the Great Tiger
When you deal damage, you may change its type to air or physical.
When you deal damage for the first time on your turn during a conflict, as long as that damage is air or physical and your Defense score is equal to or higher than 12, you deal 5 extra damage and that damage ignores Resistances.

Dismiss

Wind and Steel
Choose one option: you deal 30 air damage to every enemy present on the scene; or until the end of the current scene, you and every ally present on the scene may treat your Defense score as being equal to 12 (you may use the normal score if better). This score increases to 13 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 14 if you are level 40 or higher.

arcana.name: Arcanum of Damocles
arcana.description:
Merge

Impending Judgment
You have Resistance to dark and light damage.
Once per turn during a conflict, you may use an action to choose one enemy you can see and choose one action among the following: Attack, Guard, Objective, and Spell. If you do, until the start of your next turn that enemy loses 10 Hit Points whenever they perform the chosen action (after the action has been resolved). This amount increases to 20 Hit Points if you are level 30 or higher.

Dismiss

Rain of Swords
You deal 30 light damage to every enemy present on the scene. Each creature who loses Hit Points due to this damage suffers shaken.

arcana.name: Arcanum of Fafnir
arcana.description:
Merge

Scales of the Ardent Sovereign
You have Resistance to fire damage. Additionally, as long as you are not in Crisis, you also have Resistance to physical damage.
All damage you deal becomes fire, its type cannot change, and it ignores Resistances; as long as you are in Crisis, it also ignores Immunities.
When you deal damage with a spell, if that spell deals damage to only one creature, it deals 10 extra damage.

Dismiss

Molten Gold
You deal 20 fire damage to every enemy present on the scene, or 30 fire damage if you are in Crisis; this damage ignores Immunities and Resistances. Then, you and every ally present on the scene regain 2 Inventory Points for every enemy reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage.

arcana.name: Arcanum of Huginn & Muninn
arcana.description:
Merge

Winged Messengers
You have Resistance to air and bolt damage; additionally, you are immune to dazed.
At the end of your turn during a conflict, you may choose one creature you can see. If you do, choose one option: the Game Master reveals one of that creature's Traits; or, the Game Master reveals that creature's Affinity to one damage type of your choice.

Dismiss

Stormborn Twins
Choose air or bolt. You deal 20 damage of the chosen type to one creature you can see; then, you deal 20 damage of the other type to one creature you can see (the same or a different one). Damage dealt by this effect ignores Resistances; additionally, it ignores the Immunities of any creature you know two or more Traits of.

arcana.name: Arcanum of Lady Higanbana
arcana.description:
Merge

Scarlet Blossoms
If you have the Counterattack Skill, it also applies to enemy ranged attacks.
During conflict scenes, as long as you are merged with this Arcanum and it is not your turn, your attacks deal 5 extra damage, or 10 extra damage if you are also in Crisis.

Dismiss

Sepulchral Shroud
You deal 40 dark damage to one creature you can see; damage dealt by this effect ignores Immunities and Resistances. If a creature loses Hit Points this way, they cannot recover Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

arcana.name: Arcanum of Maneki-Neko
arcana.description:
Merge

Paw Slap
After you perform a Magic Check or Accuracy Check, you may choose one of the numbers shown by the dice rolled in the Check: that number becomes your meowgic nyamber and replaces any meowgic nyamber you previously obtained.
After a creature you can see performs a Check, if you have a meowgic nyamber, you may expend it to replace the number shown by one of the dice with that number. If you do, that Check cannot generate a new meowgic nyamber.
When this Arcanum is dismissed, if you have a meowgic nyamber, you lose it.

Dismiss

Coin Cascade
You deal 30 physical damage to every enemy present on the scene. If you lost a meowgic nyamber by dismissing this Arcanum, the type of this damage changes based on the number you lost: air (1 and 6), bolt (2 and 7), fire (3 and 8), ice (4 and 9), earth (5 and 10), dark (11 or higher).

arcana.name: Arcanum of Marchosias
arcana.description:
Merge

Glyphclaws
You are immune to shaken and weak.
Once per turn during a conflict, you may use an action to deal an amount of physical damage equal to (10 + twice the number of Heroic Skills you have acquired) to each of up to two enemies you can see; if you do and at least one of those enemies loses Hit Points due to this damage, you gain 1 Glyph Point.
When this Arcanum is dismissed, you lose all Glyph Points.

Dismiss

Seal of Fire
You deal 30 fire damage to one enemy you can see; this damage ignores Immunities and Resistances. If you lost 3 or more Glyph Points by dismissing this Arcanum, choose one option for this effect: it deals 10 extra damage; or it deals damage to each of up to two enemies you can see (instead of only one enemy).

arcana.name: Arcanum of Rangda
arcana.description:
Merge

Haunting Dance
After you and/or one or more allies you can see lose Hit Points, you gain 1 Sorcery Point.
All damage you deal becomes poison, its type cannot change, and you deal extra damage equal to your current Sorcery Points.
When this Arcanum is dismissed, you lose all Sorcery Points.

Dismiss

Feast of Body and Soul
You deal an amount of poison damage equal to (the amount of Sorcery Points you lost by dismissing this Arcanum, multiplied by 5) to one enemy you can see. If this damage reduces that enemy to 0 Hit Points, you and every ally you can see recover an amount of HP and MP equal to that enemy's Crisis score.

arcana.name: Arcanum of Tiamat
arcana.description:
Merge

Supreme Serpent
You have Resistance to ice damage.
When you deal damage, as long as that damage is ice, you deal 5 extra damage and all that damage ignores Resistances.
Once per turn during a conflict, you may use an action to perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped. If you do, all damage dealt by the attack becomes ice, its type cannot change, and every creature who loses Hit Points due to that damage suffers slow.

Dismiss

Tides of an Endless Ocean
Choose one option: fill 2 sections of every Clock present on the scene; or erase 2 sections of every Clock present on the scene; or you force every soldier-rank enemy present on the scene who is in Crisis and is also not a Villain to immediately leave the scene.
